[[File:Surro_Possessed.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vitiate possesses Jedi Master Surro on Ziost.]]
'''Possession''' was an ability where a [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]], usually a malevolent one, took over a living being's body and directed their actions.

[[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] demonstrated the ability to share his essence with many individuals, transforming them into extensions of his will (known as [[Children of the Emperor]]) and embedded these individuals within the enemy ranks to serve as his eyes and ears on a galactic scale. In addition, during the [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] massacre he was able to possess nearly all sentient lifeforms on the planet.

[[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] Proved being able to use this ability when she possessed Dooku to fight Darth Sidious, though Sidious remarked that even if she had possessed Dooku's body she lacked all of his skill, Talzin was defeated easily.

[[Marka Ragnos]] possessed [[Tavion Axmis]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] in his bid to return to the material world. While possessing Axmis, he was able to use his powers through her.
